feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, who played dads, cops and commanding officers, has died
entry.summary: Skerritt was Captain Dallas in Alien, Viper in Top Gun, and a small town sheriff in the TV series Picket Fences.

entry.title: Federal judge restricts DHS field operations looking for noncitizen voters
entry.summary: The judge found the department's field operations to identify noncitizens who voted likely violated the Voting Rights Act, which bars voter intimidation.

entry.title: Betty Gilpin seeks out 'anti-algorithm' projects, like 'The Lowdown' and 'Widow's Bay'
entry.summary: "There's an understandable pull in my industry to make things ... super safe, super familiar," Gilpin says. She wants to go the other way. Gilpin currently stars in the noir drama The Lowdown.

entry.title: You're invited to a party at Duke Ellington's house in 'Once Upon a Time in Harlem'
entry.summary: In '72, filmmaker William Greaves hosted a cocktail party for the surviving members of the Harlem Renaissance. Our critic says the footage is "like watching a 50th college reunion set on Mt. Olympus."

entry.title: Tiny Desk Radio: Shirley Caesar, Sam Smith, CeCe Winans
entry.summary: We take y'all to church on this episode. We presents three artists backed by choirs behind the Desk. Look for Tiny Desk Radio on your local NPR station.

entry.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
entry.summary: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

entry.title: Achy from sitting at a desk all day? Try doing this
entry.summary: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

entry.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
entry.summary: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. 6 in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.
